attribution_finding: Full-payment conclusion is authentic 1960 majority. The subsequent language attributed to 1958 is found in the 1960 majority/syllabus, not supplied 1958 pages.
fidelity_finding: First passage's bracketed Section is a transparent replacement for statute symbol. Second purported 1958 quotation changes source identity, not merely OCR typography.
pinpoint_finding: 1960 conclusion 177 correct. Full-tax/congressional-intent language occurs in 1960 at 150–151; 1958 pp.65,69 do not provide supplied quotation.
scope_and_cutoff_finding: Both decisions precede 1970 cutoff, so wrong year/source does not itself mean cutoff leakage. Preserve income-tax refund and federal district court scope, not every tax or every refund forum.
proposed_action_not_applied: Correct the second source to Flora on rehearing 362 U.S.145,150–151 (1960) or use a genuine 1958 passage; no rating change.

ledger_excerpt:
From Flora v. United States, 362 U.S. 145, 177 (1960):
"[Section] 1346(a)(1), correctly construed, requires full payment of the assessment before an income tax refund suit can be maintained in a Federal District Court."   
From Flora v. United States, 357 U.S. 63, 65, 69 (1958):
"The language of § 1346(a)(1) can be more readily construed to require payment of the full tax before suit than to permit suit for recovery of a part payment... the legislative history is barren of any clue to congressional intent."
